newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Elbit Systems Q4 EPS $0.30 VS $0.35.
newsitem.headline: Elbit Systems Q4 EPS $0.30 VS $0.35.

text.p: The company, a maker of defence electronics equipment, noted that the results mainly pre-dated the Elbit group's breakup into three separate companies, which occurred in November 1996. A spokesman said the 1996 figures were not pro forma.
Elbit said the decline in net profit for full-year 1996 was due to higher research and development expenditures as well as costs connected with the group's reorganisation
The company declared a dividend of $0.05 a share for the fourth quarter payable May 14.
Elbit said its orders backlog as of December 31 was $614 million, compared with $599 million a year earlier. It said 76 percent of the backlog was for export, up from 66 percent a year ago.
